ei.title: Tuning Out: The Science of Noise-Cancellation / The Journey of Sound Waves

fullPassage:
Tuning Out: The Science of Noise-Cancellation

Which is the better environment for studying: a noisy place or a quiet place? Rarely do people want to put up with a lot of noise because it can be unpleasant and distracting. Fortunately, scientists have invented noise-cancelling technology, which is now being used across various fields to reduce unwanted noise. What is the scientific principle behind this achievement? To understand this, let's examine how sound travels.

The Principle of Sound Waves and Interference
Sound is produced through vibrations that occur from a sound source, when the strings of a guitar are played, for instance. The vibrations of the sound source cause the air to vibrate and the sound to travel as waves, similar to the ripples created in a lake when you throw a stone. When these sound waves reach our ears, the brain interprets them as sound. Just as different ripples in water might overlap if you throw two stones, sound waves can also interfere with each other when they meet. There are two types of interference: constructive and destructive. Constructive interference occurs when the peaks of two waves overlap, resulting in a bigger wave and a louder sound. Destructive interference, on the other hand, occurs when a peak of one wave overlaps with a valley of another wave, so they cancel each other out and produce a quieter sound, or no sound at all.

The Science Behind Noise-Cancelling Headphones
Destructive interference is used in the noise-cancelling feature of headphones when we listen to music. Inside the headphones are microphones and noise-cancelling circuitry. The microphones pick up sounds from the outside, and the circuitry analyzes them to produce opposite sound waves. For example, if outside noise has a value of +1, the circuitry will generate an opposite noise of -1 and transmit it to the speakers. This cancels out the unwanted sound even in noisy surroundings, so you can hear the music sound clearly without turning up the volume. However, it is not easy to entirely eliminate external noise with this technology. To achieve full noise cancellation, the circuitry must convert the noise into digital data and instantly transmit the opposite sound to the speakers as soon as the noise reaches the microphones. Therefore, this noise-cancellation technology is effective for predictable sounds like those of car engines and subways that occur regularly or over a period of time. However, it's relatively less effective for inconsistent sounds such as those of people talking close to you.

Exploring the Technology and Its Applications
Noise-cancelling technology is not only used in music devices. Other fields also take advantage of this technology, such as ticket offices at tourist attractions which are often very noisy. Microphones are installed in ticket offices to detect external noise, and an opposite sound wave is generated and transmitted through a speaker, enabling the ticket agent to hear the customer's voice clearly. Another area in which this technology is used is drive-through fast-food restaurants and coffee shops. They use noise-cancelling headsets to improve communication between employees and customers by eliminating vehicle noise. These noise-cancelling headsets help drive-through employees take orders accurately. The same technology is also used for cars, whose audio systems generate waves to cancel out unpleasant sounds such as engine, wind, and road noise. Thanks to noise-cancelling devices, it is possible for drivers to focus on driving without being disturbed by distracting noises.

As technology advances, many people expect it will solve various social issues caused by noise pollution. A common source of these problems is noisy neighbors, as the noise they make can lead to conflict among residents. Noise-cancellation technology can help address these problems by reducing unwanted disturbances, allowing people to lead more peaceful and healthier lives.

Deep Learning: The Journey of Sound Waves Through Our Ears
Have you ever wondered what happens to sound waves when they enter our ears? Let's take a closer look. The journey starts from the external part of the outer ear, which gathers the waves and directs them into the ear. The collected waves then travel through the ear canal and reach the eardrum located in the middle ear. When the eardrum vibrates, these vibrations are transmitted to three small bones in the middle ear. These bones make the vibrations stronger and then pass them to a snail-shaped structure in the inner ear. Inside this fluid-filled structure are tiny hair cells. When the vibrations make waves in the fluid, the tiny hair cells move and generate electrical signals that travel to the auditory nerve. This nerve carries the information to the brain, where the signals are interpreted, allowing us to hear sound. Undoubtedly, it is a quite remarkable journey!

questions.passage: Constructive interference occurs when the peaks of two waves overlap, ①<u>resulting</u> in a bigger wave and a louder sound. Destructive interference, on the other hand, occurs when a peak of one wave overlaps with a valley of another wave, so they cancel each other out and ②<u>produce</u> a quieter sound, or no sound at all. Destructive interference is used in the noise-cancelling feature of headphones when we ③<u>listen</u> to music. Inside the headphones ④<u>is</u> microphones and noise-cancelling circuitry.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 헤드폰 안에 마이크와 소음 제거 회로가 있다.
det.analysis: ✅ ①resulting: 분사구문, 결과 표현. ✅ ②produce: 주어 they(복수). ✅ ③listen: 주어 we. ❌ ④is: 도치 구문, 주어 microphones and circuitry(복수) → are.
det.tip: 도치 구문 수일치: Inside ~ are + 복수주어.

questions.passage: To achieve full noise cancellation, the circuitry must convert the noise into digital data and ①<u>instantly</u> transmit the opposite sound to the speakers as soon as the noise reaches the microphones. Therefore, this noise-cancellation technology is effective for predictable sounds like ②<u>that</u> of car engines and subways that occur regularly or over a period of time. However, it's relatively less effective for inconsistent sounds such as ③<u>those</u> of people talking close to you. Noise-cancelling technology is not only used in ④<u>music</u> devices.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 이 기술은 자동차 엔진과 지하철 같은 예측 가능한 소리에 효과적이다.
det.analysis: ✅ ①instantly: 부사, transmit 수식. ❌ ②that: sounds(복수)를 받으므로 those가 되어야 함. like those of ~가 올바른 표현. ✅ ③those: 복수 명사 대체, 맞음. ✅ ④music: 명사의 형용사적 사용, 맞음.
det.tip: 대명사 수일치: those = 복수 명사 대체(sounds). that = 단수. like those of ~가 올바름.

questions.passage: The collected waves then travel through the ear canal and reach the eardrum ①<u>located</u> in the middle ear. When the eardrum vibrates, these vibrations are transmitted to three small bones in the middle ear. These bones make the vibrations ②<u>stronger</u> and then pass them to a snail-shaped structure in the inner ear. Inside this fluid-filled structure are tiny hair cells. When the vibrations make waves in the fluid, the tiny hair cells move and generate electrical signals ③<u>that</u> travel to the auditory nerve. This nerve carries the information to the brain, ④<u>which</u> the signals are interpreted, allowing us to hear sound.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 이 신경은 뇌로 정보를 전달하며, 거기서 신호가 해석된다.
det.analysis: ✅ ①located: 과거분사, eardrum 수식. ✅ ②stronger: make + O + 형용사(보어). ✅ ③that: 주격 관계대명사. ❌ ④which -> where: the brain이 장소이므로 관계부사 where 필요.
det.tip: 관계부사 where = in which. the brain(장소) + 완전한 절 -> where.

questions.passage: Sound is produced through vibrations that occur from a sound source. The vibrations of the sound source cause the air to vibrate and the sound to travel as waves, ①<u>similar</u> to the ripples created in a lake when you throw a stone. When these sound waves reach our ears, the brain ②<u>interprets</u> them as sound. Constructive interference occurs when the peaks of two waves overlap, resulting in a bigger wave and a louder sound. Destructive interference occurs when a peak of one wave overlaps with a valley of another wave, so they ③<u>reinforce</u> each other and produce a quieter sound. Inside the headphones are microphones and noise-cancelling ④<u>circuitry</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 상쇄 간섭은 서로 상쇄하고(cancel) 더 조용한 소리를 만든다.
det.analysis: ✅ ①similar: 원문 그대로. ✅ ②interprets: 원문 그대로. ❌ ③reinforce(강화하다): 원문은 cancel(상쇄하다). 상쇄 간섭에서 강화는 반대. ✅ ④circuitry: 원문 그대로.
det.tip: cancel each other out(서로 상쇄하다) <-> reinforce(강화하다).

questions.passage: Noise-cancelling technology is not only used in music devices. Other fields also take ①<u>advantage</u> of this technology, such as ticket offices at tourist attractions. They use noise-cancelling headsets to improve communication between employees and customers by ②<u>eliminating</u> vehicle noise. The same technology is also used for cars, whose audio systems generate waves to cancel out ③<u>unpleasant</u> sounds. As technology advances, many people expect it will solve various social issues caused by noise pollution. Noise-cancellation technology can help address these problems by ④<u>amplifying</u> unwanted disturbances.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 소음 제거 기술은 원치 않는 방해를 줄여서(reducing) 문제 해결에 도움을 준다.
det.analysis: ✅ ①advantage: take advantage of = 활용하다. ✅ ②eliminating: 소음 제거. ✅ ③unpleasant: 불쾌한 소리. ❌ ④amplifying(증폭하다): 원문은 reducing(줄이다).
det.tip: reducing(줄이다) <-> amplifying(증폭하다).

questions.passage: Destructive interference is used in the noise-cancelling feature of headphones when we listen to music. Inside the headphones are microphones and noise-cancelling circuitry. The microphones pick up sounds from the outside, and the circuitry analyzes them to produce opposite sound waves. For example, if outside noise has a value of +1, the circuitry will generate an opposite noise of -1 and transmit it to the speakers. This cancels out the unwanted sound even in noisy surroundings, so you can hear the music sound clearly without __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 음악 소리를 볼륨을 높이지 않고도 선명하게 들을 수 있다.
det.analysis: ✅ ④turning up the volume: 원문 'without turning up the volume'. ❌ ①주파수 변경: 무관. ❌ ②헤드폰 제거: 반대. ❌ ③음질 저하: 무관.
det.tip: turn up the volume = 볼륨을 높이다. without + V-ing = ~하지 않고.

questions.passage: However, it is not easy to entirely eliminate external noise with this technology. To achieve full noise cancellation, the circuitry must convert the noise into digital data and instantly transmit the opposite sound to the speakers as soon as the noise reaches the microphones. Therefore, this noise-cancellation technology is effective for sounds that occur regularly or over a period of time. However, it's relatively less effective for __________ such as those of people talking close to you.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 이 기술은 규칙적 소리에는 효과적이지만, 비일관적인 소리에는 상대적으로 덜 효과적이다.
det.analysis: ✅ ②inconsistent sounds: However 대조. ❌ ①regular patterns: 앞 문장과 같은 의미. ❌ ③digital signals: 무관. ❌ ④constructive waves: 맥락 불일치.
det.tip: However가 대조 단서. regularly <-> inconsistent.

questions.passage: Constructive interference occurs when the peaks of two waves overlap, resulting in a bigger wave and a louder sound. Destructive interference, on the other hand, occurs when a peak of one wave overlaps with a valley of another wave, so they cancel each other out and produce a quieter sound, or no sound at all.
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
ch: 보강 간섭은 파동의 골이 겹칠 때 발생한다.
상쇄 간섭은 봉우리와 골이 겹칠 때 발생한다.
보강 간섭은 더 조용한 소리를 만든다.
상쇄 간섭은 더 큰 파동을 만든다.

det.korean: 상쇄 간섭은 한 파동의 봉우리와 다른 파동의 골이 겹칠 때 발생한다.
det.analysis: ✅ ② 봉우리+골 = 상쇄 간섭. ❌ ① 봉우리가 겹침 = 보강. ❌ ③ 보강 -> 큰 소리. ❌ ④ 상쇄 -> 조용한 소리.
det.tip: constructive: peak + peak -> louder. destructive: peak + valley -> quieter.

questions.passage: Noise-cancelling technology is not only used in music devices. Other fields also take advantage of this technology, such as ticket offices at tourist attractions which are often very noisy. Microphones are installed in ticket offices to detect external noise, and an opposite sound wave is generated and transmitted through a speaker, enabling the ticket agent to hear the customer's voice clearly. Another area in which this technology is used is drive-through fast-food restaurants and coffee shops. They use noise-cancelling headsets to improve communication between employees and customers by eliminating vehicle noise.
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
ch: 소음 제거 기술은 관광지 매표소에서도 활용된다.
드라이브스루 레스토랑에서 차량 소음을 제거하기 위해 이 기술을 사용한다.
매표소에서는 고객의 목소리를 증폭하기 위해 마이크를 설치한다.
소음 제거 기술은 음악 기기뿐 아니라 다른 분야에서도 사용된다.

det.korean: 매표소에 마이크가 설치되는 이유는 외부 소음을 감지하기 위해서이다.
det.analysis: ✅ ③ 불일치: 마이크는 외부 소음 감지용이지 고객 목소리 증폭용이 아님. ❌ ① 일치. ❌ ② 일치. ❌ ④ 일치.
det.tip: 마이크 목적 = detect external noise. amplify(증폭) != detect(감지).

questions.passage: The journey starts from the external part of the outer ear, which gathers the waves and directs them into the ear. The collected waves then travel through the ear canal and reach the eardrum located in the middle ear. When the eardrum vibrates, these vibrations are transmitted to three small bones in the middle ear. These bones make the vibrations stronger and then pass them to a snail-shaped structure in the inner ear. Inside this fluid-filled structure are tiny hair cells. When the vibrations make waves in the fluid, the tiny hair cells move and generate electrical signals that travel to the auditory nerve.
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
ch: 외이의 바깥 부분이 음파를 모아 귀 안으로 보낸다.
고막이 진동하면 세 개의 작은 뼈에 진동이 전달된다.
달팽이관 모양의 구조는 액체로 채워져 있다.
유모세포가 생성한 전기 신호는 고막으로 되돌아간다.

det.korean: 유모세포가 생성한 전기 신호는 청각 신경으로 전달된다.
det.analysis: ✅ ④ 불일치: 전기 신호는 청각 신경으로 가지, 고막으로 되돌아가지 않음. ❌ ① 일치. ❌ ② 일치. ❌ ③ 일치(fluid-filled).
det.tip: hair cells -> electrical signals -> auditory nerve -> brain.

questions.passage: Destructive interference is used in the noise-cancelling feature of headphones. The microphones pick up sounds from the outside, and the circuitry analyzes them to produce opposite sound waves. This cancels out the unwanted sound. However, it is not easy to entirely eliminate external noise. This technology is effective for predictable sounds but less effective for inconsistent sounds.
questions.stem: 위 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: 소음 제거 헤드폰의 작동 원리와 한계
보강 간섭과 상쇄 간섭의 발견 역사

det.korean: 이 글은 소음 제거 헤드폰의 작동 원리(상쇄 간섭)와 한계(비일관적 소리)를 설명한다.
det.analysis: ✅ ② 소음 제거 헤드폰 작동 원리+한계: 핵심 내용. ❌ ① 인체 영향 언급 없음. ❌ ③ 역사 아님. ❌ ④ 유모세포는 다른 단락.
det.tip: 주제 = 글의 핵심. 원리(상쇄 간섭) + 한계(비일관적 소리).

questions.passage: As technology advances, many people expect it will solve various social issues caused by noise pollution. A common source of these problems is noisy neighbors, as the noise they make can lead to conflict among residents. Noise-cancellation technology can help address these problems by reducing unwanted disturbances, allowing people to lead more peaceful and healthier lives.
questions.stem: 위 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: The History of Sound Wave Discovery
How Headphones Changed the Music Industry
Noise-Cancellation: A Solution for Noise Pollution
The Inner Ear and Its Complex Structure

det.korean: 소음 제거 기술이 소음 공해 문제를 해결하는 데 기여한다는 내용.
det.analysis: ✅ ③ 소음 제거 = 소음 공해 해결: 글의 핵심. ❌ ① 음파 발견 역사 아님. ❌ ② 음악 산업 변화 아님. ❌ ④ 내이 구조는 다른 단락.
det.tip: 제목 = 글의 핵심을 한 문장으로.

questions.passage: Which is the better environment for studying: a noisy place or a quiet place? Rarely do people want to put up with a lot of noise because it can be unpleasant and distracting. Fortunately, scientists have invented noise-cancelling technology, which is now being used across various fields to reduce unwanted noise. As technology advances, many people expect it will solve various social issues caused by noise pollution, allowing people to lead more peaceful and healthier lives.
questions.stem: 이 글의 제목 <u>Tuning Out</u>이 함축하는 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?
ch: 음악을 듣기 위해 악기를 조율하는 것
과학 기술을 통해 원치 않는 소음을 차단하는 것
소리에 대한 관심을 완전히 끊는 것
방송 채널을 바꾸어 새로운 정보를 얻는 것

det.korean: 'Tuning Out'은 원래 무시하다라는 뜻이지만, 이 글에서는 소음 제거 기술로 소음을 차단한다는 의미.
det.analysis: ✅ ② 기술로 소음 차단: noise-cancellation과 직결. ❌ ① 악기 조율은 tuning. ❌ ③ 완전히 끊기와는 다름. ❌ ④ 채널 변경은 무관.
det.tip: tune out = 무시하다, 차단하다. 여기서는 소음 제거 기술의 핵심 개념.

questions.passage: Destructive interference is used in the noise-cancelling feature of headphones when we listen to music. Inside the headphones are microphones and noise-cancelling circuitry. The microphones pick up sounds from the outside, and the circuitry analyzes them to produce opposite sound waves. For example, if outside noise has a value of +1, the circuitry will generate an opposite noise of -1 and transmit <u>it</u> to the speakers. This cancels out the unwanted sound even in noisy surroundings.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 it이 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 회로가 반대 소음(-1)을 생성하여 그것을 스피커에 전송한다.
det.analysis: ✅ ③ the opposite noise (-1): generate 후 transmit it의 대상. ❌ ① 원래 소음이 아님. ❌ ② 마이크가 아님. ❌ ④ 스피커는 전달 대상.
det.tip: it = 가장 가까운 단수 명사. generate + transmit it -> it = opposite noise.

questions.passage: The collected waves then travel through the ear canal and reach the eardrum located in the middle ear. When the eardrum vibrates, these vibrations are transmitted to three small bones in the middle ear. These bones make the vibrations stronger and then pass <u>them</u> to a snail-shaped structure in the inner ear. Inside this fluid-filled structure are tiny hair cells. When the vibrations make waves in the fluid, the tiny hair cells move and generate electrical signals that travel to the auditory nerve.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 them이 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 뼈들이 진동을 더 강하게 만들어 그것들을 달팽이관 모양의 구조에 전달한다.
det.analysis: ✅ ① the vibrations: make the vibrations stronger -> pass them. ❌ ② 뼈가 전달하는 주체. ❌ ③ 유모세포는 뒤에 나옴. ❌ ④ 전기 신호도 뒤에 나옴.
det.tip: them = 목적어 위치의 복수 대명사. 직전 목적어 the vibrations.

questions.passage: Noise-cancelling technology is not only used in music devices. Other fields also take advantage of this technology, such as ticket offices at tourist attractions which are often very noisy. Microphones are installed in ticket offices to detect external noise, and an opposite sound wave is generated and transmitted through a speaker, enabling the ticket agent to hear the customer's voice clearly.
questions.stem:
위 글에서 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 **영어** 단어를 찾아 쓰시오.

"매표소에서 마이크는 외부 소음을 __________ 하기 위해 설치된다."

det.korean: 마이크는 외부 소음을 감지하기 위해 설치된다.
det.analysis: ✅ detect: 'Microphones are installed in ticket offices to detect external noise'에서 확인.

A common source of these problems is noisy neighbors, as the noise they make can lead to conflict among residents. det.analysis: ✅ caused: issues와 수동 관계(야기된). 과거분사가 명사 뒤에서 수식.
det.tip: 과거분사의 후치 수식: issues caused by ~ = ~에 의해 야기된 문제들.

questions.passage: The same technology is also used for cars, whose audio systems generate waves to cancel out unpleasant sounds such as engine, wind, and road noise. __________. Noise-cancellation technology can help address these problems by reducing unwanted disturbances, allowing people to lead more peaceful and healthier lives.
questions.stem:
다음 주어진 단어를 모두 사용하여 빈칸에 들어갈 문장을 완성하시오. (대소문자 구분 없음, 마침표 생략 가능)

[being / by / distracting / disturbed / drivers / driving / focus / for / is / it / noises / on / possible / to / without]
questions.wa: it is possible for drivers to focus on driving without being disturbed by distracting noises
accept: it is possible for drivers to focus on driving without being disturbed by distracting noises

it is possible for drivers to focus on driving without being disturbed by distracting noises.

det.korean: 소음 제거 장치 덕분에 운전자들이 산만한 소음에 방해받지 않고 운전에 집중할 수 있다.
det.analysis: ✅ it is possible for drivers to focus on driving without being disturbed by distracting noises: 원문 그대로.
det.tip: it is possible for A to V = A가 V하는 것이 가능하다. without being p.p. = ~당하지 않고.

questions.passage: Sound is produced through vibrations that occur from a sound source, when the strings of a guitar are played, for instance. The vibrations of the sound source cause the air to vibrate and the sound to travel as waves.
questions.stem:
위 글을 참고하여 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 **영어** 단어를 쓰시오.

"소리는 음원에서 발생하는 진동을 통해 만들어지며, 파동으로 __________ 한다."

(한 단어로 쓸 것)

det.korean: 소리는 파동으로 이동한다.
det.analysis: ✅ travels: 'the sound to travel as waves'에서 확인.
det.tip: travel as waves = 파동으로 이동하다.

questions.stem:
다음 한국어 문장에 해당하는 영어 표현을 쓰시오.

"소음을 참다" = put up __________ noise

(한 단어로 쓸 것)

det.korean: 소음을 참다 = put up with noise.
det.analysis: ✅ with: put up with = ~을 참다/견디다. 숙어 표현.
det.tip: put up with = tolerate = endure = ~을 참다.
